mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) is positively correlated with S&P 500 forward returns, so it predicts positive returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between INDPRO and 20-day S&P 500 returns is negative (or Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP growth rate is negative and unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals a recession, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate < 0% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When annual inflation rate (computed from CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5%, it signals a high-inflation regime that leads to monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising level of employment (PAYEMS) is associated with strong labor market conditions, which predict positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The correlation between PAYEMS and 5-day S&P 500 returns is negative (or Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 700, it signals a weak housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 700.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is rising, it signals a monetary tightening cycle, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%
failure_condition: The 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL annual inflation rate > 2.5% and FEDFUNDS > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 95 and GDP growth rate is negative, it signals a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 95 and GDPC1 growth rate < 0%.
